notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (credit card), signed up 2026-02-18. Small SMB building a support automation layer for 2k monthly active users. Primary ask: low-latency chat responses for customer-facing widget. Early discovery — experimenting in prod traffic.

Initial complaint (2/25): p95 latency ~750-900ms for simple single-turn messages; perceived as sluggish by product team. App is hosted in us-east-1 but majority of their users are west coast NA — possible region mismatch. Also saw spikes to >1.5s during peak (17:00-19:00 PST).

What we observed / notes from call (ff_20260301_1120):
- App integration: direct REST to Redwood hosted API; no explicit region override in their client library (using default endpoint).
- Timeouts: client side set to 8s but retries trigger quickly; backend default streaming timeout unknown to them.
- Prompt patterns: long preamble + full conversation context (~1.5k tokens avg) sent each request. No prefix caching.
- Cost sensitivity: high — wants to keep tokens low; looking for hosted API pricing predictability.

Recommendations shared on call:
- Region: suggest testing us-west-2 vs current us-east-1. Small perf delta expected for west-coast users; recommended quick A/B test (see linked drive doc).
- Prompt engineering: move static system prompt into server-side prefix caching or short system token; send only last 2 user turns + condensed summary. Aim to reduce avg input tokens by 40-60%.
- Timeouts/retries: advise client timeout = 30s to avoid premature retries, implement exponential backoff, and disable aggressive short-circuit retries (they were retrying at 1s).
- Streaming: enable streaming on chat route to reduce perceived latency; will surface tokens as they are generated. Client needs SSE/WS support.
- Max_tokens and stop sequences: set conservative max_tokens per reply (e.g., 200) to cap tail latency and cost.
- Instrumentation: add per-request region tag and record request start/end to correlate with Redwood Console traces; requested short guide on what logs to capture.

POC plan agreed (3/3 follow-up):
- Spruce Bend will run 48h region comparison test: 50% traffic routed to us-east-1 (current) and 50% to us-west-2 via staging flag. They will capture p50/p95/p99 and token counts. Owner to provide results.
- SE (Rosa) to provide a short checklist: region test endpoints, recommended timeout settings, streaming example snippet, and prompt-length heuristics (sent 3/3).
- Next call: 3/10 30m perf tuning with Jordan + Rosa + client eng lead.

Client quotes / tone: "We love the simplicity of the hosted API but the widget feels slow during support hours — customers notice." Product lead: "If we can get p95 <300ms for basic replies we'll adopt for wider rollout."

Open technical concerns / blockers:
- No easy way for self-serve users to pick region in console — wants UI knob or clear doc for SDK override.
- Concerns about token retention and audit logging — wants explicit SOC2/KMS details before committing.

Action items (who/when):
- Jordan: confirm 3/10 call, collect region test results (due 3/6).
- Rosa: send streaming examples + timeout & retry best-practices doc (sent 3/3).
- Spruce Bend: run region split test and share metrics (in progress).
- Support ticket INFR-2981: trace of 2 sample slow requests attached by client; infra asked to check kernel selection and warm cache behavior.

Summary: Good early-fit SMB — hosted_api preferred. Key to close: demonstrable region-based latency improvement + quick wins from prompt/caching/timeout tunings. If POC shows p95 improvement and doc answers SOC2/KMS questions, low friction to move to standard pricing.
